title: The 'both look at you' quarrel prompt sometimes offers a neutral will-check line to settle it and sometimes doesn't for what reads like the same kind of Osk/Tamsin dispute: present at the Vale's barrow-doors and at Iron Downs' Hundred Gallery, absent at Wardmoor's oath-stone burn (only 'back Osk' was on offer there).
where: The Oath-Ground — Circle (Wardmoor) vs. The Empty Seat (Vale) and The Hundred Gallery — Ash (Iron Downs)
